Description: Imprisoned for a double murder he says he didn't commit, banker Andy Dufresne forms an unlikely friendship and finds hope inside Shawshank prison.
The aging patriarch of an organized crime dynasty hands control of his empire to his reluctant youngest son.
Batman faces the Joker, a criminal mastermind who plunges Gotham City into anarchy.
The lives of two hitmen, a boxer, a gangster's wife and a pair of diner bandits intertwine in four tales of violence and redemption.
A kind-hearted man with a low IQ witnesses and influences several defining moments of 20th-century America.
A thief who steals secrets through dream-sharing technology is given one last job: planting an idea in a target's mind.
An insomniac office worker and a reckless soap salesman form an underground fight club that spirals out of control.
A hacker learns that his reality is a simulation and joins a rebellion against the machines that control it.
A team of explorers travels through a wormhole in space in an attempt to ensure humanity's survival.
Ten-year-old Chihiro wanders into a world of spirits and must work in a bathhouse to free her parents, who have been turned into pigs.
A poor family schemes to become employed by a wealthy household by posing as unrelated skilled workers.
